                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><h2 data-id="heading-0">我开源了一款 Canvas “瑞士军刀”，十几种“特效与工具”开箱即用</h2>
<p>一直以来，我都对 <code>Canvas</code> 的强大能力非常着迷，它就像一块充满无限可能的数字画布。</p>
<p>但是要实现的酷炫效果，必须写很多代码，比如烟花、数字雨，都要翻阅大量资料，从零开始“造轮子”。</p>
<p>于是我就自己写了个库，它不仅仅是一个视觉效果库，更是一个集成了多种实用工具的综合性解决方案。我将它打造成了一把 Canvas 的“瑞士军刀”。</p>
<p>在深入技术细节之前，先让你感受一下它的魅力：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>源码地址</strong>: <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fbeixiyo%2Fjl-cvs" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/beixiyo/jl-cvs" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/beixiyo/jl-…</a></li>
<li><strong>在线体验</strong>: <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjl-cvs.pages.dev%2FimgToFade" target="_blank" title="https://jl-cvs.pages.dev/imgToFade" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">jl-cvs.pages.dev/imgToFade</a></li>
</ul>
<img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/cdf1d77ab42c4bf3a0c9f2c662b18143~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a-F5pe256CB:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761060455&amp;x-signature=GRlHh26pB%2FPLs0Q%2BT3tavrjiPTk%3D" alt="PixPin_2025-08-04_11-01-55.gif" width="100%" loading="lazy">
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-1">📖 阅读本文，你将收获...</h3>
<p>我不想只写一篇干巴巴的功能说明书。这篇文章的灵魂在于 <strong>“分享探索的过程”</strong>，我将带你重走几个核心功能的研发之路，让你不仅知道“它能做什么”，更能理解“它是如何实现的”。</p>
<p>读完本文，你将get到以下技能点：</p>
<ul>
<li>✨ <strong>实现思路</strong>: 几个酷炫 Canvas 特效（如高性能视频截图、图片边缘识别算法、图片粒子化）的核心实现思路。</li>
<li>🚀 <strong>性能优化</strong>: 如何利用 <code>Web Worker</code> 和现代浏览器 API 优雅地处理 Canvas 的密集计算，告别界面卡顿。</li>
<li>🧩 <strong>抽象封装</strong>: 将复杂功能抽象、封装成可复用库的思考过程和实践。</li>
<li>🛠️ <strong>现成工具</strong>: 一个可以直接在你的项目中使用的，强大的 Canvas 工具库。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">🚀 技术探索之旅：从“我该怎么做”到“原来如此”</h3>
<p>接下来，我将挑选这个库的一小部分功能讲讲实现原理</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-3">💡 手写 JavaScript 图像边缘检测工具：从原理到实现</h4>
<ul>
<li>源码实现：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fbeixiyo%2Fjl-cvs%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fpackages%2Fjl-cvs%2Fsrc%2FcanvasTool%2FgetImgEdge.ts" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/beixiyo/jl-cvs/blob/master/packages/jl-cvs/src/canvasTool/getImgEdge.ts" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/beixiyo/jl-…</a></li>
<li>在线查看：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjl-cvs.pages.dev%2FimgEdgeDetection" target="_blank" title="https://jl-cvs.pages.dev/imgEdgeDetection" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">jl-cvs.pages.dev/imgEdgeDete…</a></li>
</ul>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/dcc782a9e91749b5be8028974d898882~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a-F5pe256CB:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761060455&amp;x-signature=p%2BIqPjuByl5LrSEy1wFcFZKq%2Frg%3D" alt="imgEdge.webp" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>图像边缘，是图像信息的“骨架”。但你是否想过：<strong>边缘是什么？为什么我们能“看到”边缘？我们如何用代码识别边缘？</strong></p>
<p>下面是全部流程执行步骤，我会在后面详细讲解：</p>






























<table><thead><tr><th>步骤</th><th>原因</th><th>如果省略会怎样？</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>1. 灰度化</td><td>统一亮度表达，简化计算</td><td>RGB 做梯度可能误判边缘</td></tr><tr><td>2. 卷积核计算 gx/gy</td><td>比较邻域像素差异</td><td>无法得到局部梯度</td></tr><tr><td>3. √(gx² + gy²)</td><td>得到真实“强度”</td><td>不开根号会偏向水平或垂直方向</td></tr><tr><td>4. 阈值过滤</td><td>控制边缘灵敏度</td><td>全部为白图或黑图</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p>我将从底层结构讲起，一步步推导出为什么要使用灰度图、什么是 Sobel 算法、卷积核为何这样设计，并亲手用 JavaScript 实现一套图像边缘检测工具，包含图文演示与错误分析。</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-4">🔍 一、图像到底长什么样？你看到的是 RGB 还是 01001101？</h5>
<p>让我们来揭开 <code>ImageData</code> 背后的真实样貌。</p>
<p>假设你加载一张图片 <code>100x100</code>，在浏览器中使用 <code>CanvasRenderingContext2D.getImageData()</code> 得到的是一个这样的结构：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ImageData</span> = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">100</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">height</span>: <span class="hljs-number">100</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">data</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Uint8ClampedArray</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 100 × 100 × 4 像素点</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>你以为像素只有一个颜色值？实际上每个像素是由 <strong>4 个通道</strong>组成的：</p>
<p>每 4 个值才代表一个像素点。如下图：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-txt" lang="txt">[R,G,B,A] [R,G,B,A] [R,G,B,A] ...
  P1        P2        P3
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-5">🧠 二、为啥要变成灰度图？</h5>
<p>你或许会问：<strong>边缘不是跟颜色变化有关吗？为什么要先转成灰度图？</strong></p>
<p>想象以下两种对比方式：</p>




















<table><thead><tr><th>情况</th><th>分析</th><th>会怎样？</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>直接用 RGB 做梯度</td><td>每个通道都做卷积</td><td>太复杂，还不一定准确（不同颜色通道梯度可能抵消）</td></tr><tr><td>用灰度图</td><td>每像素只一个值，表示亮度</td><td>简单直观，更稳定地表示明暗变化</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><strong>颜色不同 ≠ 有边缘；亮度突变才意味着边缘。</strong></p>
<p>所以我们使用人眼亮度感知模型进行灰度转换：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">Y = <span class="hljs-number">0.299</span> * R + <span class="hljs-number">0.587</span> * G + <span class="hljs-number">0.114</span> * B
</code></pre>
<p>👉 <code>G</code> 占比最大，是因为人眼对绿色最敏感。
👉 如果你用平均值 <code>(R+G+B)/3</code>，你会发现边缘识别效果变差。</p>
<p>获取图像灰度值代码实现如下：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 获取图像灰度化后，每个像素的颜色值
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> imageData 图片数据
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@returns</span> 0~255 Uint8Array 灰度化后的颜色值类型化数组
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">getGrayscaleArray</span>(<span class="hljs-params">imageData: ImageData</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">Uint8Array</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> grayData = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Uint8Array</span>(imageData.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> * imageData.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; imageData.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>; i += <span class="hljs-number">4</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">/** 灰度公式: Y = 0.299*R + 0.587*G + 0.114*B */</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> gray = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">round</span>(
      <span class="hljs-number">0.299</span> * imageData.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>[i]
      + <span class="hljs-number">0.587</span> * imageData.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>[i + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>]
      + <span class="hljs-number">0.114</span> * imageData.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>[i + <span class="hljs-number">2</span>],
    )
    grayData[i / <span class="hljs-number">4</span>] = gray
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> grayData
}
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-6">🔧 三、什么是 Sobel 算法？卷积核又是怎么回事？</h5>
<h6 data-id="heading-7">你先想一想：如何“识别出变化很大”的区域？</h6>
<p>我们需要一种工具，<strong>对比周围像素值的变化趋势</strong>。</p>
<p>这就是卷积核的工作：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-txt" lang="txt">你当前站在中心像素，观察它周围 8 个邻居，
用一组权重（卷积核）对这些邻居做加权求和。
</code></pre>
<p>Sobel 使用两个 3x3 卷积核，分别检测水平和垂直变化：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// sobelXKernel（检测水平边缘）：</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sobelXKernel = [
  -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
  -<span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>,
  -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>
]

<span class="hljs-comment">// sobelYKernel（检测垂直边缘）：</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sobelYKernel = [
  -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, -<span class="hljs-number">2</span>, -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
  <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,  <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,  <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
  <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,  <span class="hljs-number">2</span>,  <span class="hljs-number">1</span>
]
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>如果横向变化很大，gx 就大；如果竖向变化很大，gy 就大。</p>
</blockquote>
<h6 data-id="heading-8">🔁 示例演算：</h6>
<p>给你一个灰度图的 3x3 区域：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-txt" lang="txt">[ 10, 20, 30
  40, 50, 60
  70, 80, 90 ]
</code></pre>
<p>使用 sobelXKernel：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ini" lang="ini"><span class="hljs-attr">gx</span> = <span class="hljs-number">10</span>*(-<span class="hljs-number">1</span>) + <span class="hljs-number">20</span>*<span class="hljs-number">0</span> + <span class="hljs-number">30</span>*<span class="hljs-number">1</span> +
     40*(-2) + 50*0 + 60*2 +
     70*(-1) + 80*0 + 90*<span class="hljs-attr">1</span>
   = -10 + 0 + 30 - 80 + 0 + 120 -70 + 0 + <span class="hljs-attr">90</span> = <span class="hljs-number">80</span>
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-9">📈 四、从梯度变成边缘：为什么开根号？</h5>
<p>你已经得到了：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">gx <span class="hljs-comment">// 水平变化强度</span>
gy <span class="hljs-comment">// 垂直变化强度</span>
</code></pre>
<p>为了求出“总的变化程度”，我们用勾股定理：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">gradient = √(gx² + gy²)
</code></pre>
<p>这样你就得到了一个「梯度强度值」，越大说明图像在这一点变化越剧烈。</p>
<p>然后，我们再判断：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">gradient &gt; threshold
  ? <span class="hljs-number">255</span>
  : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>变化强度超过阈值 → 这就是边缘。</p>
</blockquote>
<p>如果你改低 <code>threshold</code>，会识别出更多边缘（包括一些噪点）；调高它，则只保留最明显的轮廓。</p>
<p>说明这个区域在水平方向变化非常剧烈。</p>
<p>代码实现如下：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">
<span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * Sobel 边缘检测
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@returns</span> 边缘检测后的图片数据
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sobelEdgeDetection</span>(<span class="hljs-params">
  grayData: <span class="hljs-built_in">Uint8Array</span>,
  width: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>,
  height: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>,
  threshold: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>,
</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">ImageData</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> edgeData = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ImageData</span>(width, height)
  <span class="hljs-comment">/**
   * 左右两边对比，中间不动
   */</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sobelXKernel = [
    -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
    -<span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>,
    -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
  ]
  <span class="hljs-comment">/**
   * 上下两边对比，中间不动
   */</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> sobelYKernel = [
    -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, -<span class="hljs-number">2</span>, -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
    <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,
    <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
  ]

  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> y = <span class="hljs-number">1</span>; y &lt; height - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>; y++) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> x = <span class="hljs-number">1</span>; x &lt; width - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>; x++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> gx = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> gy = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>

      <span class="hljs-comment">/**
       * 获取周围 3 * 3 的卷积像素点，计算梯度
       * (x-1, y-1)  (x, y-1)  (x+1, y-1)
       * (x-1, y)    (x, y)    (x+1, y)
       * (x-1, y+1)  (x, y+1)  (x+1, y+1)
       */</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> ky = -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>; ky &lt;= <span class="hljs-number">1</span>; ky++) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> kx = -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>; kx &lt;= <span class="hljs-number">1</span>; kx++) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pixelValue = grayData[(y + ky) * width + (x + kx)]
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> kernelIndex = (ky + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>) * <span class="hljs-number">3</span> + (kx + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>)
          gx += pixelValue * sobelXKernel[kernelIndex]
          gy += pixelValue * sobelYKernel[kernelIndex]
        }
      }

      <span class="hljs-comment">/** 计算梯度强度 */</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> gradient = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sqrt</span>(gx * gx + gy * gy)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> edgeStrength = gradient &gt; threshold
        ? <span class="hljs-number">255</span>
        : <span class="hljs-number">0</span>

      <span class="hljs-comment">/** 写入结果 (RGBA全设为相同值，alpha=255) */</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> index = (y * width + x) * <span class="hljs-number">4</span>
      edgeData.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>[index] = edgeStrength <span class="hljs-comment">// R</span>
      edgeData.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>[index + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>] = edgeStrength <span class="hljs-comment">// G</span>
      edgeData.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>[index + <span class="hljs-number">2</span>] = edgeStrength <span class="hljs-comment">// B</span>
      edgeData.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>[index + <span class="hljs-number">3</span>] = <span class="hljs-number">255</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// A</span>
    }
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> edgeData
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-10">💡 如何在截取视频帧时，不让我的页面卡死</h4>
<p><strong>用法很简单，甚至能一行写完</strong></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { captureVideoFrame } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@jl-org/cvs'</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 示例，使用 Web Worker 截取视频 1、2、100 秒的图片
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> srcs = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">captureVideoFrame</span>(file, [<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2</span>, <span class="hljs-number">100</span>], <span class="hljs-string">'base64'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">quality</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>,
})
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>源码实现：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fbeixiyo%2Fjl-cvs%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fpackages%2Fjl-cvs%2Fsrc%2FcanvasTool%2FcaptureVideoFrame.ts" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/beixiyo/jl-cvs/blob/master/packages/jl-cvs/src/canvasTool/captureVideoFrame.ts" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/beixiyo/jl-…</a></li>
<li>在线查看：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjl-cvs.pages.dev%2FcaptureVideoFrame" target="_blank" title="https://jl-cvs.pages.dev/captureVideoFrame" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">jl-cvs.pages.dev/captureVide…</a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>传统的方案</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>创建 Video 元素并加入 DOM</li>
<li>设置 Video 的 播放时间，这样才能截取到某一秒的画面</li>
<li>把 Video 绘制到 Canvas 上</li>
<li>调用 Canvas 的 <code>drawImage</code> 方法，把 Video 绘制到 Canvas 上</li>
<li>调用 Canvas 的 <code>toDataURL</code> 方法，把 Canvas 转换为 Base64 图片</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 获取指定秒的 Video 元素
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> onVideoSeeked&lt;R = <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>&gt;(
  <span class="hljs-attr">time</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">cb</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">video: HTMLVideoElement</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;R&gt;,
): <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;R&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> video = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'video'</span>)

  video.<span class="hljs-property">currentTime</span> = time
  video.<span class="hljs-property">muted</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
  video.<span class="hljs-property">src</span> = src
  video.<span class="hljs-property">autoplay</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
  video.<span class="hljs-property">crossOrigin</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'anonymous'</span>

  <span class="hljs-comment">/** 隐藏 Video 元素 */</span>
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">assign</span>(video.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>, {
    <span class="hljs-attr">position</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'absolute'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">top</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'-9999px'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">transform</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'translate(-9999px)'</span>,
  })
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">appendChild</span>(video)

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;R&gt;(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">resolve, reject</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    video.<span class="hljs-property">oncanplay</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">cb</span>(video)
      <span class="hljs-title function_">resolve</span>(res)
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeChild</span>(video)
    }

    video.<span class="hljs-property">onerror</span> = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">err</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">reject</span>(err)
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">body</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeChild</span>(video)
    }
  })
}
</code></pre>
<p>这个方案非常的简单，很符合直觉。但是它的所有逻辑都是在主线程上执行的</p>
<p>当你需要截取大量的图片时，这会阻塞页面渲染，造成用户操作卡顿</p>
<p>因此需要新的方案，<strong>WebWorker</strong> 实现多线程，但是 <strong>WebWorker</strong> 不能用于操作 DOM，所以我们是处理截图时用到它而已</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>新的解决方案：<code>Web Worker</code> + <code>ImageCapture</code> API</strong></p>
<p>为了解决性能瓶颈，我采用了现代浏览器提供的<code>Web Worker</code> 和 <code>ImageCapture</code> API，将繁重任务转移到后台线程处理，其核心流程如下：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>任务分发</strong>：主线程获取视频文件（或 URL）和需要截取的时间的 <strong>ImageBitmap</strong>，通过 <code>postMessage</code> 发送给 <code>Web Worker</code>。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">genWorkerData</span>(<span class="hljs-params">video: HTMLVideoElement</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">CaptureVideoFrameData</span>&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> stream = video.<span class="hljs-title function_">captureStream</span>() <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MediaStream</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> track = stream.<span class="hljs-title function_">getVideoTracks</span>()[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> imageCapture = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ImageCapture</span>(track)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> imageBitmap = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> imageCapture.<span class="hljs-title function_">grabFrame</span>()
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> timestamp = video.<span class="hljs-property">currentTime</span>

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
    imageBitmap,
    timestamp,
    <span class="hljs-attr">mimeType</span>: opts.<span class="hljs-property">mimeType</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">quality</span>: opts.<span class="hljs-property">quality</span>,
  }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>零拷贝传输</strong>：<code>ImageBitmap</code> 是一个“可转移对象” (Transferable Object)。当 Worker 将 <code>ImageBitmap</code> 传回主线程时，浏览器执行的是所有权的转移，而不是数据的复制。这个过程几乎是瞬时的（零拷贝），极大地降低了线程间通信的成本。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>数据转换</strong> <code>Web Worker</code> 收到 <code>ImageBitmap</code> 后，创建 <code>离屏Canvas（OffscreenCanvas）</code>，这是在 <code>Web Worker</code> 中使用的 Canvas，并绘制 <code>ImageBitmap</code>，然后调用 <code>convertToBlob</code> 方法，将 <code>ImageBitmap</code> 转换为 <code>Blob</code>，最后将 <code>Blob</code> 传回主线程。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">getCaptureFrame</span>(<span class="hljs-params">videoData: CaptureVideoFrameData</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { imageBitmap, timestamp, mimeType, quality } = videoData
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> canvas = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">OffscreenCanvas</span>(imageBitmap.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>, imageBitmap.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ctx = canvas.<span class="hljs-title function_">getContext</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'2d'</span>)!

  ctx.<span class="hljs-title function_">drawImage</span>(imageBitmap, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">ArrayBuffer</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">resolve, reject</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    canvas.<span class="hljs-title function_">convertToBlob</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: mimeType, quality })
      .<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (blob) =&gt; {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buffer = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> blob.<span class="hljs-title function_">arrayBuffer</span>()
        imageBitmap.<span class="hljs-title function_">close</span>()
        <span class="hljs-title function_">resolve</span>(buffer)
      })
      .<span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span>(reject)
  })
}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<p>这个方案相比其他方式，优势是全方位的。并且我也写兼容老的浏览器的代码，他会自动检测兼容性实现优雅降级。</p>
<p>它不仅在性能上远超传统 DOM 方案，也比 <code>ffmpeg.wasm</code> 方案更轻量、启动更快，是浏览器内视频截图场景的“最优解”。</p>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-11">💡 如何让一张图片 “灰飞烟灭”，像沙子一样飘散？</h4>
<ul>
<li>源码实现：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fbeixiyo%2Fjl-cvs%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fpackages%2Fjl-cvs%2Fsrc%2FimgToFade%2Fcore.ts" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/beixiyo/jl-cvs/blob/master/packages/jl-cvs/src/imgToFade/core.ts" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/beixiyo/jl-…</a></li>
<li>在线查看: <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjl-cvs.pages.dev%2FimgToFade" target="_blank" title="https://jl-cvs.pages.dev/imgToFade" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">jl-cvs.pages.dev/imgToFade</a></li>
</ul>
<p>电影中灭霸打响指把人“化作尘埃”的特效非常震撼。<code>ImgToFade</code> 功能在网页上复现了类似的效果。</p>
<p>这个效果的核心思想是：<strong>逐帧地将原图的像素点移除，并在移除的位置上创建一个粒子，让这个粒子朝特定方向运动，从而模拟出“灰飞烟灭”的视觉效果。</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/6fcbc8d2598e4f0db26b614b537dcaa7~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a-F5pe256CB:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761060455&amp;x-signature=UNb%2FLkr4KIVxCMeYIuUGs1K%2F56Y%3D" alt="imgFade.gif" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>下面是详细的步骤分解和代码解释：</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-12">1. 准备工作：初始化两个 Canvas</h5>
<p>为了实现这个效果，我们需要两个 <code>&lt;canvas&gt;</code> 元素，但其中只有一个是用户能看到的。</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>背景 Canvas (<code>bgCanvas</code>)</strong>: 这是最终展示给用户的 Canvas，整个动画都在这个画板上发生。</li>
<li><strong>图片 Canvas (<code>imgCvs</code>)</strong>: 这是一个在内存中创建的、用户看不见的“离屏” Canvas。它的尺寸和图片完全一样，我们用它来“存放”原始图片数据。之后所有的像素操作（比如“抹除”像素）都在这个看不见的 Canvas 上进行，处理完后再把它“贴”到背景 Canvas 上。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 让图片灰飞烟灭效果
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> bgCanvas 背景画布
 * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> opts 配置
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">imgToFade</span>(<span class="hljs-params">bgCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement, opts: ImgToFadeOpts</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 初始化参数</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { width, height, imgWidth, imgHeight, img } = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">checkAndInit</span>(opts)

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 获取用户可见的背景 Canvas 的上下文</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bgCtx = bgCanvas.<span class="hljs-title function_">getContext</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'2d'</span>)!
  bgCanvas.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> = width
  bgCanvas.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> = height

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 创建用户看不见的、用于处理图片像素的 Canvas</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { <span class="hljs-attr">cvs</span>: imgCvs, <span class="hljs-attr">ctx</span>: imgCtx } = <span class="hljs-title function_">createCvs</span>(
    imgWidth,
    imgHeight,
  )

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 将原始图片绘制到这个看不见的 Canvas 上</span>
  imgCtx.<span class="hljs-title function_">drawImage</span>(img, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, imgWidth, imgHeight)

  <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 后续步骤</span>
}
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-13">2. 记录并管理所有像素点</h5>
<p>为了能随机地从图片上拾取像素点，我们需要先“登记”图片上所有的像素。</p>
<ul>
<li>我们创建了一个 <code>pixelIndexs</code> 数组，它从 <code>0</code> 开始，一直到 <code>图片总像素数 - 1</code>，按顺序记录了每个像素的索引。这个数组是后续随机选取像素的关键。</li>
<li>我们使用 <code>getImageData</code> 获取了图片完整的像素数据 (<code>imgData</code>)，这是一个包含了所有像素 <code>RGBA</code> （红、绿、蓝、透明度）值的一维大数组。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> imgData = imgCtx.<span class="hljs-title function_">getImageData</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, imgWidth, imgHeight)
<span class="hljs-comment">/** 创建一个数组，用来记录图片上每一个像素的索引 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">pixelIndexs</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>[] = []

<span class="hljs-comment">/** 放入每个像素，RGBA 所以是 `imgData.data.length / 4` 四个点代表一个像素 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; imgData.<span class="hljs-property">data</span>.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> / <span class="hljs-number">4</span>; i++) {
  pixelIndexs.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(i)
}
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-14">3. 启动动画循环 (<code>drawPoint</code>)</h5>
<p>这是整个效果的核心驱动。我们使用 <code>requestAnimationFrame(drawPoint)</code> 来创建一个高频的循环（通常是每秒 60 帧），每一帧都会执行 <code>drawPoint</code> 函数里的内容。</p>
<p>在每一帧里，我们都做四件大事：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>清空背景</strong>：用指定的背景色 (<code>bgc</code>) 把背景 Canvas 整个覆盖一遍，清除上一帧的画面。</li>
<li><strong>绘制“残缺”的图片</strong>：把那个看不见的、像素正在被逐渐擦除的 <strong>图片 Canvas (<code>imgCvs</code>)</strong> 绘制到背景 Canvas 的中央。因为 <code>imgCvs</code> 上的像素越来越少，所以看起来图片就在慢慢消失。</li>
<li><strong>创建和销毁粒子</strong>：调用 <code>createAndDelParticle</code> 函数，从原图上随机挑选几个像素点，把它们变成粒子。</li>
<li><strong>绘制和移动粒子</strong>：调用 <code>drawDestroyBalls</code> 函数，让所有已经创建的粒子动起来。</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-title function_">drawPoint</span>()

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">drawPoint</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 用背景色清空整个背景 Canvas</span>
  bgCtx.<span class="hljs-property">fillStyle</span> = bgc
  bgCtx.<span class="hljs-title function_">fillRect</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, width, height)

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 将被处理过的、残缺的图片 Canvas 绘制到背景上</span>
  bgCtx.<span class="hljs-title function_">drawImage</span>(
    imgCvs,
    ...<span class="hljs-title function_">getCenterPos</span>(), <span class="hljs-comment">// 计算居中位置</span>
    imgWidth,
    imgHeight,
  )

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 创建新的粒子，并从图片 Canvas 上擦除对应像素</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">createAndDelParticle</span>(ballCount)
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 4. 更新所有粒子的位置并绘制它们</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">drawDestroyBalls</span>()

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 5. 请求浏览器在下一帧继续调用 drawPoint，形成循环</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">requestAnimationFrame</span>(drawPoint)
}
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-15">4. 像素的“湮灭”与粒子的“创生” (<code>createAndDelParticle</code>)</h5>
<p>这个函数是效果的魔法所在。在动画的每一帧里，它都会被调用，以执行以下操作：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>第一步：随机选点</strong>。通过 <code>getXY</code> 函数从 <code>pixelIndexs</code> 数组中随机取一个索引，这就代表一个随机的像素点。同时计算出这个像素在图片上的 <code>(x, y)</code> 坐标。</li>
<li><strong>第二步：获取颜色</strong>。用上一步得到的坐标从 <code>imgData</code> 中找到这个像素的 <code>RGBA</code> 颜色。</li>
<li><strong>第三步：创建粒子</strong>。在背景 Canvas 上，于像素点原来的位置创建一个 <code>Ball</code> 对象（也就是粒子），并把刚才获取到的颜色赋给它。然后把它存入 <code>destroyBalls</code> 数组统一管理。</li>
<li><strong>第四步：擦除原图像素</strong>。这是最关键的一步。我们在 <strong>图片 Canvas (<code>imgCvs</code>)</strong> 上，使用 <code>clearRect(x, y, 1, 1)</code> 把刚刚那个像素点精确地擦除掉（变成透明）。同时，从 <code>pixelIndexs</code> 数组中移除这个像素的索引，确保它不会被再次选中。</li>
<li><strong>加速消失（小技巧）</strong>：为了让图片消失得更快，代码里还有一个 <code>extraDelCount</code> 的逻辑。它会额外再随机擦除掉一些像素，但并不会为这些被额外擦除的像素创建粒子。这是一种视觉上的“作弊”，让效果更明显。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { createCvs, getImg, getPixel } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@jl-org/tool'</span>

<span class="hljs-comment">/** 获取随机像素点坐标 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">getXY</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): [<span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">index</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>] {
  <span class="hljs-comment">/** 随机像素点索引 */</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> index = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">random</span>() * pixelIndexs.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>)
  <span class="hljs-comment">/** 获取随机像素点 */</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pixelIndex = pixelIndexs[index]
  <span class="hljs-comment">/** 数组位置对宽度取余，获取行 */</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> x = pixelIndex % imgWidth
  <span class="hljs-comment">/** 数组位置整除宽度，获取列 */</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> y = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(pixelIndex / imgWidth)

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> [x, y, index]
}

<span class="hljs-comment">/**
 * 清除某个像素点 并删除像素点数组
 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">clearPixel</span>(<span class="hljs-params">x: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, y: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, index: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-comment">/** 在图片 Canvas 上擦除一个 1x1 的像素 */</span>
  imgCtx.<span class="hljs-title function_">clearRect</span>(x, y, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>)
  <span class="hljs-comment">/** 从像素索引数组中删除，防止重复选取 */</span>
  pixelIndexs.<span class="hljs-title function_">splice</span>(index, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>)
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">createAndDelParticle</span>(<span class="hljs-params">size: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; size; i++) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 随机获取一个像素点的坐标和它在索引数组中的位置</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [x, y, index] = <span class="hljs-title function_">getXY</span>()
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 获取该像素的颜色</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [R, G, B, A] = <span class="hljs-title function_">getPixel</span>(x, y, imgData)
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> color = <span class="hljs-string">`rgba(<span class="hljs-subst">${R}</span>, <span class="hljs-subst">${G}</span>, <span class="hljs-subst">${B}</span>, <span class="hljs-subst">${A}</span>)`</span>

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 在原位置创建一个粒子</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> point = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Ball</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: x + centerX, <span class="hljs-comment">// centerX 是居中偏移量</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: y + centerY, <span class="hljs-comment">// centerY 是居中偏移量</span>
      <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 其他粒子属性</span>
    })
    destroyBalls.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(point)

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 4. 从图片 Canvas 上清除这个像素</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">clearPixel</span>(x, y, index)

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 5. (作弊) 额外再清除一些像素，但不为它们创建粒子</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; extraDelCount; i++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [x, y, index] = <span class="hljs-title function_">getXY</span>()
      <span class="hljs-title function_">clearPixel</span>(x, y, index)
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-16">5. 粒子的运动与消亡 (<code>drawDestroyBalls</code>)</h5>
<p>这个函数负责管理所有“飞出去”的粒子。每一帧，它都会遍历 <code>destroyBalls</code> 数组里的所有粒子：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>更新位置</strong>：修改每个粒子的 <code>x</code> 和 <code>y</code> 坐标，让它向右上方移动。这里加了 <code>Math.random()</code> 是为了让每个粒子的运动轨迹略有不同，看起来更自然。</li>
<li><strong>重新绘制</strong>：在新的位置上把粒子画出来。</li>
<li><strong>生命周期管理</strong>：当一个粒子运动了一定时间后（<code>ball.count &gt; 100</code>），就代表它已经“飞远”了，我们就会把它从 <code>destroyBalls</code> 数组中移除，以节省性能。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">drawDestroyBalls</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; destroyBalls.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>; i++) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ball = destroyBalls[i]

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 更新粒子的位置，向右上方随机移动</span>
    ball.<span class="hljs-property">x</span> += <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">random</span>() * speed
    ball.<span class="hljs-property">y</span> -= <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">random</span>() * speed
    ball.<span class="hljs-property">count</span>++

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 在新位置绘制粒子</span>
    ball.<span class="hljs-title function_">draw</span>()

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 如果粒子“寿命”到了，就从数组中移除</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (ball.<span class="hljs-property">count</span> &gt; <span class="hljs-number">100</span>) {
      destroyBalls.<span class="hljs-title function_">splice</span>(i, <span class="hljs-number">1</span>)
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-17">总结</h5>
<p>整个过程就像这样：</p>
<ol>
<li>把一张完整的图片复制到一块隐藏的画板上。</li>
<li>开始一个动画循环，每一轮都：
<ul>
<li>在屏幕上涂一层背景色。</li>
<li>从隐藏的画板上随机抠掉几个像素点。</li>
<li>在被抠掉的像素点原来的位置，生成几个带有同样颜色的、会动的小点（粒子）。</li>
<li>把被抠过的、残缺不全的画板内容，贴到屏幕中央。</li>
<li>让所有小点都飞起来。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>不断重复这个过程，隐藏画板上的像素越来越少，飞出去的粒子越来越多，直到画板完全变透明，就形成了“灰飞烟灭”的效果。</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h4 data-id="heading-18">💡 如何打造一个功能强大的 “在线画板”？</h4>
<ul>
<li>源码实现：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fbeixiyo%2Fjl-cvs%2Fblob%2Fmaster%2Fpackages%2Fjl-cvs%2Fsrc%2FNoteBoard%2Findex.ts" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/beixiyo/jl-cvs/blob/master/packages/jl-cvs/src/NoteBoard/index.ts" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/beixiyo/jl-…</a></li>
<li>在线查看：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjl-cvs.pages.dev%2FnoteBoard" target="_blank" title="https://jl-cvs.pages.dev/noteBoard" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">jl-cvs.pages.dev/noteBoard</a></li>
</ul>
<p>除了视觉特效，这个库的另一个重要方向是“工具”。<code>NoteBoard</code> (画板) 就是一个集大成者。它不仅仅是画几条线那么简单。</p>
<img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/6270cf05427d4757a7cd09b596311663~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a-F5pe256CB:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1761060455&amp;x-signature=IwdjkzZF7tIROvml11l4BCCRCRw%3D" alt="noteBoard.webp" width="100%" loading="lazy">
<h5 data-id="heading-19">功能特性</h5>
<ul>
<li><strong>多模式绘图</strong>:
<ul>
<li><strong>画笔模式</strong> (<code>draw</code>): 进行自由涂鸦。</li>
<li><strong>橡皮擦模式</strong> (<code>erase</code>): 擦除画笔内容。</li>
<li><strong>图形绘制</strong>: 支持绘制 <strong>矩形</strong> (<code>rect</code>)、<strong>圆形</strong> (<code>circle</code>)、<strong>箭头</strong> (<code>arrow</code>) 等。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>画布操作</strong>:
<ul>
<li><strong>拖拽</strong> (<code>drag</code>): 平移整个画布。</li>
<li><strong>缩放</strong>: 通过鼠标滚轮以光标为中心进行缩放。</li>
<li><strong>右键拖拽</strong>: 支持在任意模式下按住鼠标右键进行拖拽。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>历史记录</strong>:
<ul>
<li><strong>撤销</strong> (<code>undo</code>): 撤销上一步操作。</li>
<li><strong>重做</strong> (<code>redo</code>): 恢复已撤销的操作。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>图层管理</strong>:
<ul>
<li>采用分层设计，<strong>背景图片</strong> 和 <strong>画笔/图形</strong> 分别绘制在不同的 Canvas 上，互不影响。</li>
<li>支持动态添加更多 Canvas 图层。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>图像处理</strong>:
<ul>
<li><strong>绘制背景图</strong>: 可将图片绘制到底层画布，并支持 <strong>自适应</strong> (<code>autoFit</code>) 和 <strong>居中</strong> (<code>center</code>) 显示。</li>
<li><strong>导出图像</strong>:
<ul>
<li>可导出任意指定图层 (如仅导出画笔内容)。</li>
<li>可将所有图层合并导出为一张图片。</li>
<li>支持仅导出图片内容区域，并还原为原始分辨率。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>高可定制性</strong>:
<ul>
<li>支持自定义画布尺寸、缩放范围、画笔样式 (颜色、粗细、线帽)、混合模式等。</li>
<li>提供丰富的生命周期钩子函数 (<code>onMouseDown</code>, <code>onDrag</code>, <code>onUndo</code> 等)。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>高性能</strong>:
<ul>
<li>针对高分屏 (HiDPI) 进行优化，绘图清晰不模糊。</li>
<li>路径历史记录模式性能高，内存占用低。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-20">架构设计</h5>
<p><strong>GUI</strong> 最适合的就是<strong>面向对象</strong>，所以我采用抽象类的方式开发</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-mermaid" lang="mermaid">classDiagram
    class NoteBoardBase {
        &lt;&lt;abstract&gt;&gt;
        +el: HTMLElement
        +canvas: HTMLCanvasElement
        +imgCanvas: HTMLCanvasElement
        +opts: NoteBoardOptionsRequired
        +scale: number
        +translateX: number
        +translateY: number
        +drawImg()
        +exportImg()
        +exportAllLayer()
        +setTransform()
        +clear()
        +dispose()
        +undo()*
        +redo()*
        +setMode(mode)*
    }

    class NoteBoard {
        +mode: Mode
        +history: UnRedoLinkedList~RecordPath[]~
        +drawShape: DrawShape
        +setMode(mode)
        +undo()
        +redo()
    }

    class NoteBoardWithBase64 {
        +mode: NoteBoardWithBase64Mode
        +history: UnReDoList~string~
        +setMode(mode)
        +undo()
        +redo()
        +addNewRecord()
    }

    class DrawShape {
      +shapeType: ShapeType
      +shapes: BaseShape[]
      +init()
      +undo()
      +redo()
    }

    NoteBoardBase &lt;|-- NoteBoard
    NoteBoardBase &lt;|-- NoteBoardWithBase64
    NoteBoard --&gt; DrawShape : uses
</code></pre>
<h5 data-id="heading-21">第一步：奠定基石 - 分层画布架构</h5>
<p>一个好的画板，首先要解决的问题是 <strong>“关注点分离”</strong>。如果用户在画板上绘制了一张背景图，然后开始在上面涂鸦。当用户想擦除涂鸦时，我们肯定不希望连背景图也一起擦掉。</p>
<p>解决这个问题的最佳方案就是 <strong>分层画布</strong>。</p>
<p>我们的 <code>NoteBoard</code> 采用了这个核心思想。在 <code>NoteBoardBase</code> 这个抽象基类中，我们创建了至少两个 <code>&lt;canvas&gt;</code> 元素：</p>
<ol>
<li><code>imgCanvas</code>: <strong>图片层</strong>。专门用来绘制背景图，它位于最底层。</li>
<li><code>canvas</code>: <strong>笔迹层</strong>。用于自由绘制、图形和橡皮擦，它位于上层。</li>
</ol>
<p>这两个 canvas 的尺寸完全相同，并通过 CSS 的 <code>position: absolute</code> 精确地叠放在一起。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">/** 在 NoteBoardBase.ts 的构造函数中 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">abstract</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">NoteBoardBase</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attr">el</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span>
  canvas = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'canvas'</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 笔迹层</span>
  ctx = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getContext</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'2d'</span>)!
  imgCanvas = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'canvas'</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 图片层</span>
  imgCtx = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">imgCanvas</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getContext</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'2d'</span>)!

  <span class="hljs-title function_">constructor</span>(<span class="hljs-params">opts: NoteBoardOptions</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">el</span> = opts.<span class="hljs-property">el</span>

    <span class="hljs-comment">/** 设置 z-index 来控制堆叠顺序 */</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span>.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">zIndex</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'20'</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 笔迹层在上</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">imgCanvas</span>.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">zIndex</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'10'</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 图片层在下 (假设)</span>

    <span class="hljs-comment">/** 将它们都添加到用户提供的容器中 */</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">el</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">appendChild</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">imgCanvas</span>)
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">el</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">appendChild</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span>)

    <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 其他初始化</span>
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>这么做的好处是什么？</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>操作独立</strong>：我们可以独立地清空笔迹层 (<code>canvas</code>) 而完全不影响图片层 (<code>imgCanvas</code>)。</li>
<li><strong>性能优化</strong>：背景图通常是静态的，绘制一次后就不再变化。将其放在独立的 <code>imgCanvas</code> 中，意味着我们不需要在每次笔迹更新时都重绘一遍昂贵的背景图。</li>
<li><strong>高扩展性</strong>：未来如果想增加更多图层，比如一个专门的“文本层”，只需按照同样模式添加一个新的 canvas 即可。</li>
</ul>
<h5 data-id="heading-22">第二步：攻克难关 - 实现撤销与重做</h5>
<p>这是画板最核心、也最有趣的功能。我们有两种主流的实现思路，<code>NoteBoard</code> 项目将它们都实现了，分别对应 <code>NoteBoardWithBase64</code> 和 <code>NoteBoard</code> 两个类。</p>
<h6 data-id="heading-23">方案一：快照法 (简单粗暴，但有效)</h6>
<p>这是 <code>NoteBoardWithBase64</code> 采用的策略。</p>
<p><strong>原理</strong>: 在每一次用户完成操作后 (例如，一笔画完后鼠标抬起)，我们立刻将整个笔迹层 <code>canvas</code> 的内容转换成一张 <code>base64</code> 格式的图片，并将其作为一个“历史快照”存储起来。</p>
<p>由于历史记录采用存储 <code>base64</code> 的原因，所以没有实现绘制形状（圆形、矩形...），因为绘制形状时需要在每一次鼠标移动时重新绘制整个画布，但是重画 <code>base64</code> 性能很差</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">NoteBoardWithBase64</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_ inherited__">NoteBoardBase</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// history 是一个支持撤销/重做的链表结构</span>
  history = createUnReDoList&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>&gt;()

  onMouseup = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e: MouseEvent</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// ...</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">isDrawing</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addNewRecord</span>() <span class="hljs-comment">// 添加新纪录</span>
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">addNewRecord</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">/** 将当前 canvas 内容导出为 base64 */</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> base64 = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">exportMask</span>()
    <span class="hljs-comment">/** 添加到历史记录 */</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">history</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(base64)
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">undo</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">history</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">undo</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (base64) =&gt; {
      <span class="hljs-comment">/** 清空当前画布 */</span>
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">clear</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (base64) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">/** 从历史记录中取出上一张快照图片 */</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> img = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">getImg</span>(base64)
        <span class="hljs-comment">/** 将快照重新绘制到画布上，实现“撤销” */</span>
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ctx</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">drawImage</span>(img, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
      }
    })
  }
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>优点</strong>: 实现逻辑极其简单，撤销/重做的性能是恒定的，无论画布内容多复杂。</li>
<li><strong>缺点</strong>: <strong>内存开销巨大</strong>！如果画布很大，历史记录很多，会迅速消耗掉大量内存。同时，所有内容都被“压平”了，我们丢失了对单个图形或笔画的控制能力。</li>
</ul>
<h6 data-id="heading-24">方案二：指令法 (优雅，且强大)</h6>
<p>这是 <code>NoteBoard</code> 类采用的策略，它借鉴了 <strong>指令模式 (Command Pattern)</strong> 的思想。</p>
<p><strong>原理</strong>: 我们不记录像素，而是记录用户的 <strong>“意图”</strong> 或 <strong>“指令”</strong>。</p>
<ul>
<li>用户画了一根线？我们记录下这根线所有关键点的坐标。</li>
<li>用户画了一个矩形？我们记录下这个矩形的 <code>[x, y, width, height]</code> 以及它的颜色、线宽等属性。</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">/** 每一笔的路径记录结构 */</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">RecordPath</span> = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">moveTo</span>: [<span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>]
    <span class="hljs-attr">lineTo</span>: [<span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>]
  }[]
  <span class="hljs-attr">canvasAttrs</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">CanvasAttrs</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 这笔的样式</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">shapes</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">BaseShape</span>[] <span class="hljs-comment">// 这笔包含的图形</span>
  <span class="hljs-attr">mode</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Mode</span>
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">NoteBoard</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">extends</span> <span class="hljs-title class_ inherited__">NoteBoardBase</span> {
  history = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UnRedoLinkedList</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">RecordPath</span>[]&gt;()

  onMousedown = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e: MouseEvent</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">/** 每次下笔，就创建一个新的、空的记录节点 */</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">history</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>([])
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">isDrawing</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
  }

  onMousemove = <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">e: MouseEvent</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">isDrawing</span>)
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { offsetX, offsetY } = e

    <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 绘制逻辑 ctx.lineTo(...) ...</span>

    <span class="hljs-comment">/** 将“指令” (坐标) 记录下来 */</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> lastRecord = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">history</span>.<span class="hljs-property">curValue</span>
    lastRecord[lastRecord.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>].<span class="hljs-property">path</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">moveTo</span>: [<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">drawStart</span>.<span class="hljs-property">x</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">drawStart</span>.<span class="hljs-property">y</span>],
      <span class="hljs-attr">lineTo</span>: [offsetX, offsetY],
    })

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">drawStart</span> = { <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: offsetX, <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: offsetY }
  }

  <span class="hljs-title function_">undo</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 1. 指针移动到上一个历史状态</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">history</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">undo</span>()

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 2. 清空画布</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">clear</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)

    <span class="hljs-comment">// 3. 重绘！</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">//    - 遍历当前历史状态中所有的 shapes，重绘所有图形</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">//    - 遍历当前历史状态中所有的 path，重绘所有笔迹</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">drawRecord</span>()
  }
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li><strong>优点</strong>: <strong>内存占用极低</strong>。非常灵活，理论上我们可以对历史中的任意一个“指令”进行修改，比如选中某个画好的图形并移动它。</li>
<li><strong>缺点</strong>: 实现更复杂。每次撤销/重做都需要清空画布并完全重绘一次，如果场景中有成千上万个对象，可能会有性能瓶颈 (但在画板场景下通常足够快)。</li>
</ul>
<p>对于一个需要长久发展的项目，<strong>指令法无疑是更优越的选择</strong>。</p>
<h5 data-id="heading-25">第三步：丝滑的体验 - CSS Transform 实现缩放与拖拽</h5>
<p>如何实现画布的缩放和拖拽？</p>
<p>大家的第一反应可能是使用 Canvas 的 API：<code>ctx.scale()</code> 、<code>ctx.setTransform()</code> 和 <code>ctx.translate()</code></p>
<p>但是这个复杂度有点高，需要额外计算很多因素，所以我暂时选择用 <strong>CSS Transform</strong> 方案。缺点就是无法实现无限画布，优点就是简单。</p>
<p><del>我们完全不碰 Canvas 的变换 API。缩放和拖拽的逻辑仅仅是去修改 <code>canvas</code> 和 <code>imgCanvas</code> 这两个 HTML 元素的 CSS 样式。</del></p>
<p><strong>我的最新力作已经完全实现了无限画布版本</strong>（这是老版本的说明）</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">NoteBoardBase</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ...</span>
  <span class="hljs-comment">/**
   * 拖拽、缩放画布
   * <span class="hljs-doctag">@param</span> callback 在设置完成 canvas 后执行的回调
   */</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setTransform</span>(<span class="hljs-params">callback?: (styles: {
    transform: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
    transformOrigin: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  }) =&gt; <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> transformOrigin = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.mousePoint.x}</span>px <span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.mousePoint.y}</span>px`</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> transform = <span class="hljs-string">`scale(<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.scale}</span>, <span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.scale}</span>) translate(<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.translateX}</span>px, <span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.translateY}</span>px)`</span>

    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">canvasList</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">item</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      item.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span>.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">transformOrigin</span> = transformOrigin
      item.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span>.<span class="hljs-property">style</span>.<span class="hljs-property">transform</span> = transform
    })

    callback?.({
      transform,
      transformOrigin,
    })
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>为什么这会如此丝滑？</strong>
因为我们将繁重的变换计算任务交给了浏览器的渲染引擎。浏览器可以利用 <strong>GPU 硬件加速</strong> 来处理 CSS Transform，这个过程发生在独立的合成层 (Compositor Layer) 上，完全不阻塞主线程，也不会引起整个 Canvas 的重绘。结果就是如黄油般顺滑的缩放和拖拽体验。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-26">🛠️ 如何在你的项目中使用？</h3>
<p>我已经把它发布到了 <code>NPM</code>，你可以非常方便地在你的项目中使用它。</p>
<p><a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.npmjs.com%2Fpackage%2F%40jl-org%2Fcvs" target="_blank" title="https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jl-org/cvs" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">www.npmjs.com/package/@jl…</a></p>
<p><strong>安装依赖</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash"><span class="hljs-comment"># pnpm</span>
pnpm add @jl-org/cvs

<span class="hljs-comment"># npm</span>
npm i @jl-org/cvs
</code></pre>
<p>如果你想探索所有的 Demo，可以把项目克隆到本地运行。</p>
<p><strong>本地开发</strong>:</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash"><span class="hljs-comment"># 克隆仓库</span>
git <span class="hljs-built_in">clone</span> https://github.com/beixiyo/jl-cvs.git

<span class="hljs-comment"># 安装依赖</span>
pnpm install

<span class="hljs-comment"># 构建核心包</span>
pnpm build
<span class="hljs-comment"># 启动测试页面</span>
pnpm <span class="hljs-built_in">test</span>
</code></pre>
<p>访问 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A5173" target="_blank" title="http://localhost:5173" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">http://localhost:5173</a> 即可看到所有效果的演示。</p></div></div>
